title: Bulk-Buy Packaging Avoidance
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=recycling:weight stream=packaging_avoided
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(kg) as packaging_avoided_kg by _time
| eventstats sum(packaging_avoided_kg) as total_packaging_avoided
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how much packaging weight you avoid by buying staples in bulk or refill form.
value: Packaging avoidance is a concrete zero-waste win that often disappears from memory without a running total.
implementation: Capture packaging avoided as a dedicated `recycling:weight` stream and summarize it monthly and cumulatively.
visualization: Column chart of monthly packaging avoided weight.

references.title: EPA — reducing wasted food at home

grandmaExplanation: It watches how much wrapping and container waste you skipped by buying smarter in bulk.
